summary: First-finish smoke tests on Local Music Indexer. All backend endpoints (config, seed-sample, scan, scan/status, tracks, stats, identify, PATCH tracks with apply_to_file, cover-art nano-banana, organize) responded 200 with correct shape. Frontend renders header, stats, table, filter, FixModal and CoverModal correctly.
passed: GET /api/tracks and ?status=unknown filter both return correct data
PATCH /api/tracks/{id} with apply_to_file=true updated DB (status→identified, source=manual) AND wrote ID3 tags to .mp3 (verified via mutagen re-read: title/artist/album applied)
POST /api/identify (bulk) returned 200 with {updated:0, errors:2, total_checked:2} for synthetic samples (expected — no AcoustID match)
POST /api/cover-art model=nano-banana returned 200 with valid data:image/png;base64 URL (~1.2MB payload)
Frontend loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, header 'LOCAL·MUSIC.INDEXER' visible
Status indicators: fpcalc: READY, acoustid: CONFIGURED, llm: ONLINE
SCAN flow via folder-path-input + scan-trigger-button populates 5-row table with correct stats
FixModal opens via table-row-fix-{id}, save-edits-button present
CoverModal opens via table-row-cover-{id}, model-selector-dropdown present
action_items: Optional: verify gpt-image-1 model path (only nano-banana exercised due to first-finish latency budget). Recommend deferring to full testing pass.
Note: stats identified count becomes 3 after a manual PATCH promotes an unknown track — this is correct expected behavior, not a bug.
